picks.what: The Church of St. Mary Magdalene on Alexandrovsky Square, postcard
picks.why: the city’s main old cathedral (demolished in the 1930s) seen across the square; caption and website watermark trimmed

gaps: P0–P3: nothing (only postal covers and Pavlovsk items); P5: nothing datable after 1914; P6: existing 2021 aerial view kept
notes: Trimming the caption clips the top of the central cross slightly. The file is only 1024 px wide. #11 is the same church on a black-and-white card but handwriting covers the sky. #10–#14 are dated only “before 1917” on Commons and look like 1900s cards (#14 is postmarked 1905), so they are not P5 views. #12 (harbor with a steamer) shows no town. #1, #6, #7 and #16 are Pavlovsk, not Mariupol. #15 (night aerial with the water tower, 2020) is not better than the existing view.
